brief.name: Dext
brief.summary: Dext is a Visual Studio Code extension for AI conversations, coding assistance, implementation planning, and reusable TypeScript workflows. Developers use Ask, Agent, Plan, and Code modes, attach workspace context, review changes, and revisit conversation history. Dext integrates installed Codex CLI, Claude CLI, and DeepSeek Harness agents, Skills, and configured MCP tools. Code workflows run in a Node child process with typed APIs. The extension also provides project knowledge and architecture exploration, diagram generation, and optional inline code completion.

evidence.note: Product purpose and reusable workflows with APIs, Skills, and MCP tools.

capabilities.description: Coordinate conversation tabs and turns, interactive questions, streamed results, task progress, and saved history. Execute resumable plans with verification and acceptance, and support turn reviews and knowledge adoption.

Select agent profiles and permissions, route CLI requests, supervise execution, and manage Codex app-server and DeepSeek Harness sessions. Register MCP tools and credentials, discover Skills, and expose API and global resource browsing.

Define and register callable APIs, generate declarations and authoring metadata, and dispatch workflows through the Node kernel. Validate and repair structured results, render document templates, and convert conversations into editable workflow skeletons.

Resolve file, selection, symbol, and project references; manage attachment staging, storage, clipboard exchange, and navigation. Apply shared context exclusions, validate editor patches, and execute workspace commands with trust and containment checks.

Initialize projects, index source structure and ownership, and generate responsibility indexes from repository evidence. Manage project intent, conversation context, settings, persisted knowledge, suggested revisions, semantic reviews, and evidence freshness.

Build knowledge-reading topics and architecture views, validate diagram semantics and architecture rules, and manage rendering, playback, and snapshots. Generate and embed Archify artifacts and support Mermaid views, evidence navigation, and diagram exports.

Configure completion models, assemble eligible editor context, schedule and score candidates, and adapt suggestions using acceptance feedback and memory. Integrate with VS Code completion events and evaluate quality and latency.

capabilities.canonicalName: Application composition and shared editor infrastructure
capabilities.description: Compose extension services and lifecycle wiring, restore editor tabs, and provide the reference-aware Monaco composer with TypeScript assistance and theme integration. Share Markdown diagram rendering and conversation viewport diagnostics.

contexts.purpose: Coordinate conversation tabs and turn execution, connect attachments, plans, reviews and history, queue messages until the webview is ready, and track notifications for turns awaiting input.
Convert provider elicitation schemas into question forms, broker agent input requests and responses, and present interactive cards with retained response drafts.
Persist conversations and turns, normalize saved responses, manage titles, pins, favorites, ordering and layout preferences, and render history views and Markdown exports.

Route requests to provider runners and execute CLI-backed invocation, conversation and structured-result requests. Detect completion, track CLI tool activity and provide timeout supervision shared by provider implementations.
Manage Codex app-server connections and conversation execution, translate protocol events and user questions, handle cancellation and input cleanup, and normalize Codex errors.

Resolve Harness executables, launch settings, permissions and presets; run provider sessions through the transport and local bridge; and adapt interactive questions and structured-result tool submissions.

contexts.canonicalName: Typed workflow dispatch and execution contracts
contexts.purpose: Dispatch typed callable invocations and conversations to deterministic handlers, agents and MCP operations, adapt returned results, and define shared execution data contracts and cancellation semantics.

Compile callable definitions into Ax and Zod contracts, bridge CLI generation into Ax, extract and serialize structured results, normalize patch results, and repair validation failures using snapshot assertions.

contexts.canonicalName: Workflow API definitions and authoring support
contexts.purpose: Define built-in callables and result types, specialize CLI callable fields and metadata, generate API documents and TypeScript declarations, format signatures, and support composer symbol discovery, imports and unavailable-type notices.

Run Code-mode workflows across the extension host and Node child process, including kernel messaging, module loading, runtime dispatch, asynchronous work tracking, stream serialization and resume replay.

Represent and resolve file, selection, symbol and directory context; project references into display text; and construct insertion, replacement and removal edits for references in composer source and input arguments.

contexts.canonicalName: Attachment staging and conversation file storage
contexts.purpose: Stage clipboard and file attachments, preserve exact clipboard text, enforce attachment limits, and manage storage locations, prompt references and retention for attachment and plan files.

Define resource sessions and documents, load API reference catalogs, and provide searchable list/detail navigation and editing controls for APIs, MCP resources, rules and skills through shared host editors and renderers.
Construct and retain turn reviews, track run identity and acceptance feedback, handle adoption of project knowledge suggestions, and render review results and acceptance controls.

Extract and stream plan documents, derive file names, track tasks through resumable execution and verification rounds, aggregate changes across runs, associate changes with tasks, and present plan acceptance decisions.

contexts.canonicalName: Project responsibility index generation and evolution
contexts.purpose: Package repository evidence for AI-generated responsibility indexes and diagrams, define and validate project intent, assess index ownership quality, derive C4 topics, and reconcile regenerated indexes with existing analysis.

Define and normalize project knowledge, search and select project references for conversation context, resolve run review presets, and validate workspace settings for project paths, evidence and plans.

contexts.canonicalName: Project diagram validation and rendering lifecycle
contexts.purpose: Define diagram semantics and renderer contracts, evaluate declared architecture rules, select rendering adapters, coordinate rendering and playback presentation, and maintain snapshots with semantic, evidence and layout comparisons.

Translate project diagrams into Archify documents, construct and repair layouts, validate and render artifacts through subprocesses and temporary files, and provide trusted command messaging for embedded Archify viewers.

contexts.canonicalName: Inline completion generation and feedback adaptation
contexts.purpose: Configure completion models and credentials, assemble context and examples, schedule and cache model requests, budget and score candidates, and use accepted-edit outcomes and session or workspace memory to adapt subsequent completions.
Execute completion evaluation cases and sequences across memory modes, assemble sequence context, collect quality and timing measurements, and summarize evaluation results.
Load MCP manifests, register and discover tools, verify servers, access configured transports, and manage scoped credentials for authenticated connections.

Discover workspace files and project objects, capture editor selections and attachments, and exchange clipboard and dropped-file references with the host. Format stable project references, display reference chips, and resolve output links for navigation.

contexts.canonicalName: Shared Monaco runtime and theme integration
contexts.purpose: Initialize Monaco language contributions and workers, extract VS Code token styles, and translate them into Monaco theme rules shared by composer editing and conversation source highlighting.

Collect eligible document context, configure completion models, and host inline completion generation in VS Code. Connect candidate handling, adaptation, memory, and feedback to completion acceptance, diagnostics, and evaluation commands.

Parse a supported subset of gitignore-style patterns and evaluate normalized paths using ordered rules and negation. Supply common file-exclusion semantics to inline completion and application-level agent checks.

Validate patch targets, ranges, expected text, and optional content hashes in trusted workspaces. Apply changes through VS Code, save affected documents, and return resulting document references or conflict results.

Execute workflow commands with workspace trust checks, resolved working-directory containment, validated environment overrides, bounded timeouts, and limited captured output. Return structured process status and timing.

Coordinate project initialization, progress, hydration, workspace evidence access, and project editor tabs. Resolve evidence depth and generation budgets from configuration, and expose project overview, navigation, and settings controls.

contexts.canonicalName: Project knowledge persistence, review, and freshness
contexts.purpose: Persist project definitions and knowledge artifacts, manage suggested revisions and review decisions, and support semantic edits and merges. Compare source baselines, validate evidence facts, and update knowledge freshness while preserving user decisions.

contexts.canonicalName: Source structure indexing and responsibility evidence
contexts.purpose: Index source declarations, dependencies, and build metadata; derive responsibility candidates and check source-file ownership. Package structural evidence and source excerpts for project knowledge generation.

contexts.canonicalName: Project knowledge reader and architecture exploration
contexts.purpose: Build reading topics and evidence checks, render topic articles and architecture notes, and operate the bundled project reader with Mermaid and Archify views. Resolve diagram targets, validate export payloads and evidence paths, and manage diagram-task cancellation.

Define forms, validate answers, and manage pending host interactions through submission, cancellation, and disposal. Render selection controls, Markdown descriptions, and dialogs, and translate agent questions and answers into forms and conversation-history presentation.

contexts.canonicalName: Callable API registration and execution contracts
contexts.purpose: Register and enumerate callable methods with source precedence and external-method removal. Define shared validation schemas for API results and execution wire steps, and provide namespace grouping for method presentation.
Discover skill packages across workspace and configured roots with precedence, extract metadata, maintain a reloadable catalog, and load selected skill instructions with workspace-path validation.
Parse template specifications, validate field declarations and presets, derive output schemas, substitute placeholders, and validate rendered text or structured documents in supported formats.

Convert successful conversation turns into editable TypeScript workflow skeletons with callable steps, shared parameters, result types, and recorded confirmation prompts. Preserve code-mode turns as comments and leave confirmation branching for the workflow author.

Serialize Mermaid rendering requests, apply the webview theme, and insert diagram previews into Markdown used by interactive forms and the project reader. Retain source text and isolate rendering failures.

Measure conversation viewport geometry, painted and in-flow content, hidden elements, and clipping. Expose diagnostic reports and optional scroll and resize logging to identify excess blank space and unreachable output.

Extension lifecycle, application service composition, command and provider registration, restoration and configuration wiring, and host operations for workflows, conversations, resources, projects and credentials.

contexts.canonicalName: Shared turn presentation and task progress
contexts.purpose: Shared live-conversation and history presentation models and rendering adapters for turn sections, structured messages, JSON output, replayable traces and task progress, including provider task-report normalization.
Provider profiles, model and permission options, TOML configuration parsing, configured defaults, saved execution selections and their composer-facing presentation.
Shared editor panel ownership, tab identity, persisted page state, restoration coordination and HTML framing for resource and project editors.
Monaco composer editing, TypeScript declarations, completion and diagnostics, reference-aware paste, and atomic reference tokens with source-position mappings.

Conversation tabs, drafts, execution modes, agent and resource controls, composer control overflow layout, streamed results and review interactions through host–webview contracts; presentation helpers for diffs, elapsed time, Markdown copying and source highlighting with reference chips.
